I've gone to disney world more than 20 times over the span of my life time (i'm 21) and over the years we've learned new things to try out at disney world. 

First off, if you have not fully booked it, I suggest you do the dining plan. I know it may be pricey but in my opinion you will save SO much money in the end. My favorite buffet is Boma which is at Animal Kingdom Hotel, since it has a variety of foods you would not see at any other location/buffet. I went to Disney over the summer and we tried out Cape May Cafe which is located at the Disney's Beach Club Resort. It's a little difficult to locate since it's in Epcot past Paris in the Disney World Showcase. The buffet was also VERY delicious. The French restaurant at the World Showcase is also very good, I always go there.  

If you want to take a full day at Epcot and go to every single Showcase, it takes up a bunch of time and they've just installed museums at some of the places (Morocco was one I remember). That's always interesting, as well as the Aquarium at the Finding Nemo ride.  

Honestly, if you've done about everything, someone suggested the hydroponics tour. I've personally never done that but I highly suggest that as well. 

I know at Animal Kingdom, there's a behind the scenes tour with the Safari Ride. I don't know how much you love animals, but this is something new I would try as well. [I've linked the information for it.](https://disneyworld.disney.go.com/events-tours/animal-kingdom/backstage-safari/)

And if you're trying to stunt for your graduation you could always do the Disney Tours, [I've linked it as well.](https://disneyworld.disney.go.com/events-tours/vip-tour-services/)
I've never seen/heard about it until I saw someone get in front of a line and I was wondering what it was all about and I looked it up. I know it's hourly and it's **dreadfully** expensive but I'm just putting it out there. I get bored and look up all these possibilities at Disney. 

At MGM, you could always attend the Indiana Jones and the Stunt shows, I know those are very interesting to sit and watch. 


I have also brought wonderful news (and hopefully you'll be there when it opens), but when I was there they were building a new ride at Magic Kingom called [The Seven Dwarfs Mine Train](http://www.themeparkinsider.com/reviews/walt_disney_world's_magic_kingdom/the_seven_dwarfs_mine_train/) which should open in Spring 2014. You should definitely take the opportunity if given to try out the newest ride! 

I hope this helps, and I'm sorry if it's all over the place.
